authority_notes.coherent_simulation: RESEARCH. `any_td` is the ONLY statistic with a non-zero deployed reconciliation weight (0.25); every other family deploys at 0, so its reconciled probability sits at the MARKET mean with the football shape and is reported but never ranked. It does NOT make touchdown props validated bets: the football-only model did not beat the market overall on any family (any_td Brier 0.1583 vs the market's 0.1570 over 3,720 settled rungs), and where the two disagreed by more than 0.10 the market won on every family.
